description: Change brand settings. Only the fields sent are changed. With a project in scope this sets that website's own override and leaves the account defaults — and every other website — alone; without one it changes the account defaults every website inherits. The accent colour must be a hex value — it is interpolated into a stylesheet that renders on customers' websites.

project.description: A project id from list_projects. Runs this call in that project instead of the connection default.

name: update_brand
title: Update brand
